title: Crafting Your System

edits.reason: The intro bullets teach a concrete threshold the chart never draws: 'if the drawdown has not exceeded your maximum acceptable level, the system is valid' and 'When the system exceeds its maximum acceptable drawdown level: that is the time to revamp and rebuild.' The markLine at 106 sits just below the 110 dip floor so the existing 'System: Drawdown OK' point (idx 6, ~110) reads as ABOVE tolerance = system still valid. The markArea bands the 113-peak-to-110-trough giveback so the drawdown is shown as a measured region, not a stray candle, supporting 'Trust your system during drawdowns.' Both values inside band 98-138; area sits exactly on the dip leg envelope.

Pre-cut DECISION CONTEXT only. The explanation/rule teach the single decision threshold: 'The only trigger for a genuine system review is if the drawdown has exceeded the predefined maximum acceptable level built into the system.' Drawing this threshold just BELOW the visible losing-streak trough (idx 7 closes ~82) frames the decision honestly ('are we still above max? yes -> trust it') without revealing the recover-vs-fail outcome, which stays in revealMarkPoints. yAxis nudged from the auditor's 78 to 80: the drop leg (100->82) bottoms with candle lows near ~80-81, so 78 risks clipping into empty bottom padding; 80 sits right at the visible floor and still below the 82 trough. Pink matches the chapter's loss/risk convention.
